datasets.dataset: NREL PVDAQ (Open Energy Data Initiative data lake)
datasets.timezone_note: Local standard time at a fixed UTC-5 offset, derived from the published measured_on and utc_measured_on columns. The offset is constant across the range, confirming no daylight-saving shift.
datasets.weather_source: Instruments co-located with the array (published in the same PVDAQ record)
datasets.irradiance_scale_basis: Published in W/m^2 with calc_scale=1, calc_offset=0. Validated against a pvlib Ineichen clear-sky model transposed to the sensor's plane-of-array (tilt 5°, azimuth 90°) reference: 95th-percentile clear-sky index 1.20 (a calibrated sensor sits near 1.0).
datasets.license_note: NREL PVDAQ data published via the Open Energy Data Initiative (OEDI) as a public dataset. Attribution to NREL/OEDI required; consult the dataset landing page for current terms before redistribution.
processing_notes: Channels selected from the system metrics table by declared units: ac_power=InvPAC_kW_Avg (metric_id=82509, kW); irradiance=RefCell1_Wm2_Avg (metric_id=82496, W/m^2) [plane-of-array]; temperature=AmbTemp_C_Avg (metric_id=82498, C); wind_speed=WindSpeedAve_ms (metric_id=82567, m/s)
Resampled from 1-minute to 15-minute intervals by mean.
Negative irradiance and power (instrument offsets) clamped to zero.
Assembled 526717 native samples into 35136 usable intervals.
known_limitations: No fault labels. Measured telemetry carries no annotated failures, so this dataset supports forecast evaluation only — detection metrics come from injected scenarios instead.
Where several calibrated irradiance sensors exist, the lowest metric_id is used; alternates are not cross-checked, so a drifting sensor would go unnoticed.
Irradiance channels published only in raw millivolts are rejected rather than converted, since the dataset does not publish the instrument calibration constant.
